table: ST-3200-C001是12V 200KG.CM 串口总线智能舵机，采用全铝合金外壳、无刷电机、金属齿牙箱、飞特自主研发的TTL控制板，12位高精度磁编码传感器。堵转扭矩200kg.cm，能实现360度任意角度可控，多圈连续转，步进等工作模式，可实现一键设定中位功能，加速度缓启动与缓停止，能反馈位置、速度、电压、温度、负载参数，从而实现过载保护。适合应用在工业设备、机器人等小扭力传动应用场景。 ST-3200-C001 is 12V 200kg.cm serial bus smart servo，aluminum alloy case is used、brushless Motor,metal gearbox 、Feetech self researched and developed TTL control board.The stall torque is 200kg.cm，multi-turn continuous operation mode，it can realize the function of setting the middle point with one key，acceleration slow start and slow stop，can feedback position、speed、voltage、current、temperature、load parameters，thus, overload and over-current protection can be realized. It is suitable for application in industrial equipment, robot and Small torque drive application scenarios.
